source.title: Visible-Light-Promoted C–S Cross-Coupling Reaction for Synthesis of Aromatic Thioethers

reaction.notes: Step A only: coupling of 4'-bromoacetophenone with 2-chlorobenzenethiol under blue light (456 nm) in DMSO with Cs2CO3 base; N2 atmosphere; 23 °C; 5 h.
reaction.tags: visible light; C–S coupling; aryl bromide; aryl thiol; cesium carbonate; DMSO; nitrogen; Kessil PR160; 456 nm

conditions.atmosphere: N2; irradiate 456 nm, Kessil PR160 (40–50 W), 5 cm; stir 800 rpm

quench: Open to air; transfer to separatory funnel; rinse vessel with water (10 mL) and EtOAc (10 mL).
workup: Add water (50 mL). Extract with ethyl acetate (3 × 75 mL).
Wash combined organics with brine (20 mL).
Dry over anhydrous MgSO4 (7 g, 10 min). Filter and concentrate (30 °C, 225→60 mmHg).
Dissolve crude in dichloromethane (3 mL) and load onto silica column.

purification.stationary_phase: Silica gel (90 g), 5 cm × 20 cm; cotton plug protection
purification.fractions: 10 mL per fraction; collect product-rich fractions (per TLC); combine and concentrate

notes: Lamp: Kessil PR160, 456 nm, distance 5 cm; fan used to maintain 23 °C; stirring 800 rpm.
Isolated: 4.34 g (83%) of 1-(4-((2-chlorophenyl)thio)phenyl)ethan-1-one, white solid; purity 98% by qNMR.

original_procedure: In a 100 mL glass reaction tube, add 4'-bromoacetophenone, cesium carbonate, and 2-chlorobenzenethiol. Evacuate and backfill with nitrogen three times. Add dry DMSO (50 mL) to give a yellow suspension. Seal and irradiate at 456 nm with a Kessil PR160 lamp (5 cm, fan-cooled) at 23 °C with stirring (800 rpm) for 5 h. Proceed to aqueous workup and silica gel chromatography as described on the source page. [Paraphrased summary of Step A; see source URL for full text.]
